  \caption{Experiment 1: the explained network of each dataset, with the columns of the Experiment 2 run tables. Selection: Heart and MONK-2 are the original networks; WHAS500 is the lowest validation Cox loss of five seeds; Connect-4 and the synthetic sets are the largest training AUC of their runs (seed in brackets). AUCs and intervals are recomputed from each genome on its study's split (10{,}000 bootstrap resamples of the test rows) and equal the study's run record. $^\ast$WHAS500 is a Cox model: its train and test columns are Harrell's $C$. \emph{Inputs used}, \emph{hidden nodes}, \emph{enabled connections}, \emph{depth} and \emph{skip connections} are of the phenotype; \emph{skippiness} and \emph{density} are the library's \texttt{ExplaNEAT} measures on the genome, as in Experiment 2. Explanation columns are computed on the stored explanation: leaf $+$ composition annotations, node splits and identity nodes (its operations), structural / compositional coverage (the library's coverage check) and the function-preservation error (largest absolute difference between the explained model and the network on the training rows). Every explanation except the two original ones was written by one explaining agent with the frozen authoring method (v4, provenance-stamped); \emph{agent min} runs from the explanation's creation to its last timestamped write in the database (operations, evidence records, logged queries), a lower bound on the agent's wall-clock time (Connect-4 cells includes a short sandbox pause). $^\dagger$The original explanations (July 2026) predate that method and the query log, so they have no explaining time; MONK-2's pruned-input annotation sits outside the root and, as an annotation of disconnected inputs, is exempt from the single-root rule (without the exemption its compositional coverage is 0.75). No Experiment 1 explanation has recorded verification minutes, so \emph{Mike min} is blank throughout. $^\ddagger$XOR has no test set (the four rows are the whole truth table): each of the 30 seeds' first solving genome, reduced to its minimal form (exact relay collapse and greedy pruning), classifies all four rows (30 of 30); its realisations were analysed by hand, not annotated.}
